name: Photo Pinch
summary: Pick photos in a grid and delete: each pinches into a bead, drops in the bin, the grid closes up
about: Photo Pinch is a multi-select delete for galleries. Tap photos to select them and a bar slides up with the count and real size. Delete makes the picks shiver, then two fingertips pinch each photo into a round bead that arcs down into the bin with a splash, while the remaining photos glide and tilt into the gaps. Undo throws the beads back out and they grow into photos in their old places.
how: Tap a photo (or press Select) to start picking; tap again to unpick.
The bar shows how many photos and megabytes are picked.
Press Delete (or the Delete key) and watch them pinch into beads while the grid reflows.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) to grow them back; Escape or Done leaves select mode.
